reviewQuestions: Is transparency wording accurate and non-misleading?

acceptanceCriteria: Role and content distinctions are preserved.
Notices are clear, accurate and non-misleading.
The provider transition is not applied to deployer duties.

Technical feasibility must be assessed for each deployment.
Localisation presence is not legal approval.
